boundaries: All mappings use supplied TRAIN only, excluding both v1 and v2 evaluation components.
TRAIN target inversion does not establish physical quote identity or label-free scale.
Evaluation regime is target-derived for retrospective grading only, not an inference feature.
Unknown transitions/spreads invalidate downstream tests and retain unknown mass in denominators.
Future books and targets are diagnostic only; no competition trainer, features or model was modified.
No external numeric state or examples were read.
Rounding and alternative exits are fixed controls; no winner is selected for a submission.

fit.not_a_physical_quote_identity: TRAIN target inversion and common-F-stability assumptions supply the coordinate scale/spread; these are not recovered from features alone.

preregistration.quote_clock: Nonzero known decoded ask/bid moves, excluding pure representation-code changes. Unknown intervening moves invalidate the entire interval.
preregistration.rounding: nearest even origin parity0; separately frozen parity1 and half-up
preregistration.row_clock: Mean/end over the next N publication rows; not identified physical time.
